run_tests() {
    local target="$1"
    log "testing ${target}"
    require_command cargo
    cargo test -p "${target}" --no-fail-fast
}

main() {
    local targets=("fixture-one" "fixture-two" "fixture-three")
    build_all "${targets[@]}"
    for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
        run_tests "${target}"
    done
    log "done"
}

main "$@"
